findings.label: Stop-path untested
findings.detail: The abort / ledger-exhaustion branch (Req 8.4, 9.4; task 6.5) that halts new workers, drains the running set, and records stopReason has no test. Add a case that aborts or exhausts the ledger mid-run and asserts no new workers start and stopReason is set.

findings.label: workerId assignment untested
findings.detail: step.workerId set when a worker starts (Req 3.5) is not asserted on the plan in any test. Add an assertion on tracker.plan.steps[].workerId or on the onPlan payload.

findings.label: Abort labelled as time-budget
findings.detail: if (aborted()) stopReason ??= 'time-budget' reports an abort as a time-budget stop. Consider a distinct reason if downstream metrics/record (Task 8) needs to tell them apart.
